profiles.model: Compact crouched educational wheelbot; declared engineering approximation, not calibrated hardware
profiles.stateOrder: [x,z,pitch,hip,knee,x_dot,z_dot,pitch_dot,hip_dot,knee_dot,wheel_dot] relative to qref/uref; wheel absolute phase omitted by axial rotational symmetry
profiles.sensorScope: Five noisy pose channels plus an explicitly simulated wheel encoder-rate channel (sigma0.02rad/s); hardware calibration not established
profiles.trimSolver: Native qacc with fixed height/pitch; geometric COM-over-wheel initialization

modelMetadata.massAssumptions: 1 kg lumped body/drive assembly + two 0.056 kg rods + 0.08715 kg wheel/tire; not hardware identified
modelMetadata.designChoice: Hip near COM is a bounded compact-base choice, not a universal stability theorem
modelMetadata.derivedFrom: Original source-derived Upkie/sketch leg and tire dimensions/masses; new rounded base is an engineering assumption, with 1 kg lumped body/drive assembly and no identified motor assemblies or remote transmission

weightChoice.changed: Q[0,0] from 2 to 80 for faster small position commands
weightChoice.observerReason: One bounded revision after prior Qe gave 0.62–0.92 rad/s noisy wheel jitter; same measurementSigma. Quiet local-model assumption, not calibrated disturbance robustness.
